value.rationale: Sharp uniqueness of the first intrinsically torsion-bearing induced chessboard complex is a natural sparse-localization invariant of the classical M5,5 integral 3-torsion phenomenon. It distinguishes torsion inherent in a small complex from short free classes whose images are ambient torsion, and exhibits a unique 16-square homological Moore carrier mapping isomorphically to full torsion.
